The fault is concentrated in [assistantUpsellConfig.ts](/app/packages/components/hooks/assistant/assistantUpsellConfig.ts:30). Both paid builders require an addon name and add it directly to `planIDs`. Its duplicate resolver falls back to the Mail Plus addon for an unsupported plan, so either paid flow can select the wrong addon.

The shared resolver already exists in [helpers.ts](/app/packages/components/payments/core/subscription/helpers.ts:3) and returns `undefined` when a plan has no match. The fix should use it in both paid paths, seed `planIDs` with the current plan or selected plan, and add an addon only when the resolver returns one. [payments/core/index.ts](/app/packages/components/payments/core/index.ts:1) must export the resolver and `SelectedPlan`; the assistant files and [ProtonPlanCustomizer.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/payments/planCustomizer/ProtonPlanCustomizer.tsx:5) currently import `SelectedPlan` through an internal path.

The [existing upsell tests](/app/packages/components/hooks/assistant/assistantUpsellConfig.test.ts:1) cover known plans but do not cover an unsupported plan or absent addon. No project source or tests were changed; this run was limited to fault localization.

Updated the assistant upsell paths to use the shared Scribe addon resolver. Both paid flows now build `planIDs` from the selected plan and add a Scribe addon only when the resolver finds one. I also exported `SelectedPlan` and the resolver from `payments/core` and moved the affected imports to that public entrypoint.

The focused upsell tests pass (11/11), including new cases for a plan without a Scribe addon. Formatting and `git diff --check` pass. The components TypeScript check remains blocked by an unrelated `openpgp` type mismatch in `packages/crypto/lib/worker/api.ts`.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** The free user upsell still hardcodes the Scribe addon in [assistantUpsellConfig.ts](/app/packages/components/hooks/assistant/assistantUpsellConfig.ts:18). Resolve the addon with `getScribeAddonNameByPlan(PLANS.MAIL)` and add it only when the resolver returns a name, as required for all flows.

**Tests:** `yarn workspace @proton/components test --runInBand --runTestsByPath hooks/assistant/assistantUpsellConfig.test.ts payments/core/subscription/selected-plan.test.ts` passed: 2 suites, 50 tests.

**TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM:** None. This was an independent review; no project code was changed.

Fixed the free user upsell: it now resolves the Mail Scribe addon through `getScribeAddonNameByPlan` and adds it to `planIDs` only when the resolver returns a name.

The exact two test files flagged in review passed: **2 suites, 50 tests**. `git diff --check` also passed. No remaining failures or test environment problems.
